text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking around the academy,
Symboli
Rudolf spots me and
approaches.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing. I was just hoping to
speak with
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A matter has arisen that requires the
student
council's attention. It seems we
need all hands on
deck.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I missed today's
training
session to attend to it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall ensure that it is dealt with by the
end of
the day, so future sessions should
be unaffected—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there, bucko!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You need a hand, right? Well, I've got
two!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your enthusiasm, but this is
a matter
for the student council.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: C'mooon, I just wanna help out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I won't mess around! I pinky swear!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I should be enough to make up
the
difference.
choice_data_list: 手伝ってもらった方が早いかもよ

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! Awww, so much for Operation
Get
Praised...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you win! But next time, I won't take
no for
an answer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am flattered enough that you asked.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm needed in the student
council office.
I'll see you tomorrow,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf
attends to her
duties with lightning
speed. By the end of the
day, she has
finished everything.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! See? It's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just think about it! The harder I work,
the quicker
you can get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, I did not foresee my own
trainer
taking Teio's side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. But I expect you to
follow my
instructions to the letter.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! You got it, Prez! To the letter!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, I'm gonna be rolling in compliments! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, if you'll excuse us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ I'm Prez's little helper! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Symboli Rudolf manages to
clear her
student council workload by
the end of the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is thanks in no small part to Tokai
Teio
following instructions carefully,
lightening the
load on Symboli Rudolf's
shoulders.
